meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一段文字或笔记做成无人出镜的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有文字稿,想让没有实拍画面的内容变成能发布的视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn written text or notes into an explainer video with no on-camera presenter
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have written content and want a publishable video without filming anything.

howto.what: 它把你给的文本(文章、笔记、主题或简介)做成无人出镜的解说视频:画面全部按场景原创(排版、抽象图形、图表、数据可视化),项目在 videos/<项目名>/ 里按步骤搭建,最后渲染出 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你要把一段文本做成主题讲解、概念拆解或操作教程视频时触发。基于网站的宣传或导览视频不走这里(/product-launch-video);意图不明时先转 /hyperframes。

howto.what_en: It turns text you give — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video. All visuals are invented per scene (typography, graphics, diagrams, data-viz), built step by step and rendered to renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a text turned into a topic explainer, concept breakdown, or how-to video. Videos built from a website go to /product-launch-video; unclear intent goes to /hyperframes.
